title: Shikumi overhead unit graph
description:
a validated unit graph: unique names, inputs that name earlier units, and a structure that
matches its declared shape.

units.description: in dependency order: every unit appears after all of its inputs.

oneOf.description:
create an empty output and nothing else. an executor must not add a setup environment, such
as nixpkgs' stdenv, whose own cost would hide the floor being measured.

Identifier.description: a lowercase name: a letter, then letters, digits and hyphens.

oneOf.description: independent units with no inputs, for throughput.
each unit takes the one before it as its only input, for latency.

inputs.description: units whose outputs must exist before this one runs. each names an earlier unit.
